mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, we are seeing clear skies around Fireman's Park with a temperature of 56 degrees and a Waxing Gibbous moon overhead.
The Verona Police Department has published their weekly activity report for the period of August 17th to August 24th, detailing various traffic citations and assistance calls.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with trivia today at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by a full schedule of music and markets tomorrow.
Looking back at the weekly report, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on August 19th at North Main Street and Bering Drive, resulting in minor injuries and citations.

The delicious Caramel Turtle is today's flavor of the day. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM, and tomorrow you can look forward to the Chocolate Volcano flavor.
